load_model_from_path: load a 3D Gaussian Splatting model from a model directory path with config and checkpoint
load_model_with_source_override: load a model from a path while overriding the scene source_path to a new directory
load_model_with_data_root: load a model from a path using a data_root to resolve the scene source path
load_model_with_ckpt_subpath: load a model from a path using a specific checkpoint subpath instead of the latest
load_model_simple_scene: load a model from a path with simple_scene mode enabled for faster scene initialization
